scope: Washer/laundry, dishwasher sizes and fridge dimensions buying journeys
changes: Fit-led comparisons with capacity, a reason to consider each option, the installation constraint and ownership trade-off.
Comparison tables become individual labelled comparisons below 768px; approved affiliate artwork is retained.
Five unpaid retailer shopping alternatives removed following commercial review; approved affiliate buying routes and useful product comparisons retained.
Existing stainless LG GB-B400PS assessment and permitted imagery reused in the fridge dimensions guide alongside the Westinghouse top mount.
Postcode delivery, installation, removal, stacking-kit and hinge/finish checks added before ordering. No product testing or lowest-price claims added.
evidenceBasis: Existing product/manufacturer assessments: commercial-products.json sourceRecords; appliance-opportunities-review-2026-10-12.json; washer-affiliate-review-2026-10-10.json; lg-fit-max-first-look-sources-2026-10-10.md.
Live browser inspection of direct public retailer listings on 12 October. Exact model, variant and ordering interface inspected. No affiliate link clicks, cart changes or purchases.
All eight existing Good Guys laundry/dishwasher/Westinghouse product listings exposed enabled Add to Cart. LG GB-B400PS direct listing also exposed Add to Cart and correct capacity/variant.
HTTP refresh failed certificate verification; it was not bypassed. Browser evidence was used instead.
limitations: No additional affiliate program approval or commission rate was inferred. Commercial buying links require verified affiliate approval and tracking; manufacturer and editorial evidence references remain separate.
Cached search prices differed from live prices, so product prices were not published as static promises. Readers are directed to current exact-model offers and total-order checks.
Postcode-specific inventory, service eligibility and delivery dates remain reader checks. Availability is available-to-order, not a nationwide stock guarantee.

The LG top-loader alternative was researched but not added because this pass did not establish a sufficiently clear current ordering signal. No alternative was forced onto the full-width dishwasher or stacking kit.
Existing manufacturer clearances and ownership assessments retain their original dates and limits; no fresh testing or long-term reliability evidence is claimed.

measurement.notes: These are additional changes on the original change day. Keep labelled QA/internal visits separate. All commercial buying calls to action use approved affiliate offers. Merchant reports establish orders and commission; no cohort attribution from shared Amazon tracking ID.
